invariants: Every calibration binds the actual probe/lever and optical configuration
Changing target region requires registration and schedule binding
Unknown damaged status is not accepted status
Each scan point links to one move/contact/acquire/withdraw/release cycle
Final specimen version and custody equal the terminal inspected carrier
Calibration parent completion precedes dependent acquisition
Target labels alone do not prove physical target identity
Failed attempts remain archived and cannot be relabeled accepted

custody_roles.retained_probe: Array or conventional lever remains installed across dependent branches within one episode. Separate identity, mount and setup version govern calibration.
custody_roles.exchanged_specimen: Flat reference, silicon target, glass reference or cylindrical coupon is retrieved and cleaned at each branch tail.
custody_roles.final_session_teardown: After the last selected branch at each instrument, retrieve and inspect retained probe, invalidate calibration, archive and clean/store. No calibration may be reused in a later episode.
